svg.title: Design sheet · Rainbow cheek and star swoosh
svg.text: Design sheet · Rainbow cheek and star swoosh
Left cheek: rainbow with clouds (lesson 04.4, project 1). Right cheek: star swoosh (lesson 04.2).
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
Paint each rainbow stripe along one gray line. Clouds go on last, over the ends.
